originality.rationale: A full-text comparison with the 2007 unreset two-bath harmonic gyrator, the 2013 two-temperature parabolic diffusion, the 2015 resetting OU large-deviation work and the 2020 reset-to-line active Lorentz process found no implication of the present paired exact signed-area formulas and mutually exclusive bath-ratio reversal sectors. The full formula for the reset chord, the distinction between continuously accrued and jump-inclusive area, and global crossing uniqueness are evaluated here. A general moment method is not claimed as new. The inspected set is not exhaustive, and novelty awaits independent verification.
residual_risks: Prior general partial-state resetting moment papers may enable immediate specialization to the two explicit rates; the mathematical novelty judgment concerns the full evaluated global sign diagram, not moment-closure algebra.
The literature comparison is selective, not exhaustive; an unlocated theorem or table may already imply the results.
A separate angular-winding or local current observable must not be conflated with the signed stochastic area studied here.

value.rationale: The original 2007 two-thermostat harmonic gyrator motivates circulation; one-coordinate resetting naturally produces both continuous and reset-chord signed-area transport. Their qualitatively different sharp reversal sectors, counter-signed equal-temperature case, and exact rapid-reset cancellation solve a meaningful all-parameter observable-definition and transport problem, not a handpicked numerical instance. It is not a new general Markov-generator formula; useful conclusions are the physically interpretable classification and thresholds.
